# MyWestern

> MyWestern is Western Washington University's integrated student and staff portal providing centralized access to academic planning, campus services, and university applications.

MyWestern serves as the primary digital hub for WWU students and employees, integrating key systems like Banner, Canvas, Microsoft 365, and Web4U. The portal streamlines access to registration, academic planning, mobile apps, and campus resources while supporting administrative tasks like direct deposit enrollment and name changes.

## Key Topics

- Student Portal
- Canvas
- Banner
- Microsoft 365
- Web4U
- Registration
- Academic Planning
- Campus Services
- Mobile Apps
- Handshake
- Student Dashboard
- University Resources
- Student Tools
- Campus News

## Portal Access & Overview

- [Home | MyWestern | Western Washington University](https://mywestern.wwu.edu/home): MyWestern home portal with registration, academic planning, and campus resources
- [Home | MyWestern | Western Washington University](https://mywestern.wwu.edu): MyWestern student and staff portal for WWU with access to Banner, Canvas, Microsoft 365
- [Home | MyWestern | Western Washington University](https://mywestern.wwu.edu/concept): MyWestern portal concept page with Canvas, Handshake, and university tools

## Applications & Mobile Tools

- [Western Apps | MyWestern](https://mywestern.wwu.edu/western-apps): Directory of WWU mobile apps for housing, parking, dining, and digital wallet

## Creative & Makerspace Resources

- [Innovation, Tech, and Creative Resources | MyWestern | Western Washington University](https://mywestern.wwu.edu/creative-resources): WWU makerspace and creative facilities including 3D printing and equipment access

## Administrative Procedures

- [Direct Deposit Enrollment Instructions | MyWestern](https://mywestern.wwu.edu/web4u/direct-deposit-enrollment-instructions): Step-by-step guide for direct deposit enrollment via Web4U Employee Dashboard
- [Name Change Information | MyWestern](https://mywestern.wwu.edu/web4u/name-change-information): Guide for legal name and preferred name changes via Registrar's Office
